Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1004 and H5679); ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan:--Bethabara.
BiblicalUsage: The name Bethabara appears in the New Testament. You will find it in John 1:28.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bethabara matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
